verdict.rationale: The docs describe Devin as a conversational interface paired with an embedded IDE where you can follow and take over its work. They also describe Devin Desktop, which imports VS Code or Cursor settings and offers AI-powered assistance while coding. MCP gives MCP-compatible IDEs access to Devin sessions. However, no evidence shows an in-editor chat panel giving contextual help on the code you have open; the embedded IDE is Devin's own workspace, not your IDE. Missing for 10: explicit docs of in-IDE chat with editor/file context, extensions for existing IDEs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
